acceptance_rule: Every internal supporting result must be proved in Lean. A final theorem may retain only a premise that is an exact, cited theorem from the external literature, together with ordinary model and parameter assumptions.

inputs.acceptance: Prove the actual-model raw bounds from the exact external moment lemma interface; repeated indices, correlation grouping, weights, pilot and scale terms are internal.

target: q1 critical and long-memory two-bandwidth scale L1 smallness
inputs.acceptance: Derive each smallness statement from existing actual covariance, weight and bias bounds in Lean.

target: q1 and q2 finite-Hermite triangular-array CLT
inputs.allowed_external_dependency: An exact cited Gaussian subordinated triangular-array CLT may be retained if its full statement is encoded and every actual-model hypothesis is proved in Lean.
inputs.acceptance: No premise may simply restate convergence of the final finite-polynomial statistic.

target: critical and long-memory weighted fourth-correlation, mean and second-moment smallness
inputs.acceptance: Prove the actual weighted limits from local covariance limits, weight asymptotics and summability.

target: actual q1 quadratic statistic convergence to the stated second-chaos law
joined pilot long-memory quadratic limit where used
inputs.allowed_external_dependency: A precisely cited general second-chaos or Gaussian quadratic-form convergence theorem may be retained; actual kernel/operator convergence and theorem applicability are internal.
inputs.acceptance: No premise may assume convergence of the actual q1 quadratic statistic itself.
